title: Clinical Care Management Standard — Specialty Pharmacy Program
content:
Specialty pharmacists and nurses of the Specialty Pharmacy Program follow the clinical standards below for each tier.

| Tier | Maximum calendar days between clinical assessments by a specialty pharmacist | Adherence outreach for members below the threshold | Adherence threshold (proportion of days covered over the last 180 days) | Pharmacist or nurse reachable around the clock |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Specialty Open Access | 180 | No | 80% | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Preferred | 180 | No | 80% | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive | 180 | Yes | 80% | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist | 90 | Yes | 80% | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Care Management | 90 | Yes | 80% | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Total Care | 60 | Yes | 80% | Yes |

## Standard explained

- **Assessment interval.** A clinical assessment by a specialty pharmacist falls due no later than the interval shown. The interval is 180 days on the three entry tiers, 90 days on Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist and Northbridge Specialty Care Management, and 60 days on Northbridge Specialty Total Care.
- **Adherence threshold.** On every tier the threshold is a proportion of days covered of 0.8 (80%), measured over the last 180 days. Where adherence outreach runs, a member whose proportion falls below that threshold receives pharmacist outreach.

## Threshold examples (assumed adherence figures)

| Proportion of days covered | Below the 80% threshold? |
|---|---|
| 0.79 | Yes |
| 0.80 | No, it equals the threshold |
| 0.85 | No |
